text.tspan: THE CONTROLS WERE NOT APPLIED TO THE ORIGINAL RUN. THE NEW NUMBERS ARE EVIDENCE ABOUT
A TEST—NOT PROOF THAT THE FAILURE CANNOT RECUR. A RESULT FROM ONE TEST DEPENDS ON THE
WORKLOADS, CONTROLS AND CONDITIONS USED IN THAT TEST. THE BOOK CAN REPORT THE
IMPROVEMENT CLAIM WITHOUT TREATING IT AS A MEASURE OF EVERY FUTURE DEPLOYMENT.
